comments.content: The code uses dsc->text_size.x directly without checking if text_size is valid (e.g., initialized). Since text_size is a new field added to lv_draw_label_dsc_t, ensure it's always properly initialized before this function is called. Consider adding an assertion or fallback to lv_text_get_size if text_size.x is 0 and text is non-empty.
